title: Design System: Wheeler Cat — Variant E (photography re-foregrounding)

variant.role: one captured trait amplified (composition + scale bet)
variant.bet: equipment portraits restored to editorial 3:2 hero scale; hero photo becomes the layout, not a tile; cards gain photo-first composition
variant.evidence: current/assets/media/ holds 52 captured images including equipment portraits at full resolution; the captured page crops Compact_Track_Loader to a 280×180 thumbnail when the source supports 1440×810 full-bleed

differentiationFrom.A: A's hero uses SC_Hero finance creative + dark overlay; E's hero uses an equipment portrait at editorial 3:2 with NO overlay (photo carries the headline via a low-band caption plate). 3 diffs: hero asset choice (finance creative vs equipment portrait); overlay vs caption-plate composition; finance band layout (E pulls finance below service tiles to give photography the second-viewport oxygen).
differentiationFrom.B: B is palette inversion (yellow primary); E retains captured palette proportions. 3 diffs: hero ground (yellow type vs equipment photo), service tile treatment (yellow tiles vs photo-card tiles in E), no finance-band ground inversion in E.
differentiationFrom.knownWeakness: Captured photography is product-documentation tier, not editorial. E will visibly expose this gap — that exposure IS the presales artifact (tells the brand owner what a photography investment would unlock). Variant carries an explicit '_photographyMaturityNote' surfaced in the rendered file's provenance.

photographyContract.rationale: E's bet — restore equipment photography to share-of-canvas equivalent to its source resolution

heroComposition.asset: Compact_Track_Loader (captured at full resolution; reuse via current/assets/media/)
heroComposition.aspect: 3:2 (1440×960 desktop; cropped to 2:1 at >1600px for ultrawide)
heroComposition.treatment: no dark overlay; caption-plate as bottom-left card on white ground (carries headline + supporting line + primary CTA)
heroComposition.headline: FINANCING DEALS & SPECIAL OFFERS (verbatim captured) — set in caption-plate, not over photo
heroComposition.rationale: Overlay-on-photo (captured pattern) reduces both photo and type legibility; caption-plate honors both.

cardComposition.pattern: photo-first cards (image 60% of card height, text 40%)
cardComposition.aspectRatio: 4:5 for tile cards; 3:2 for hero adjacency

serviceTiles.treatment: replace icomoon glyph + dark ground with equipment-photo tile + bottom caption (FIELD SERVICE / SHOP SERVICE / etc.)
serviceTiles.rationale: Improvement #5 expanded — photography (where it exists) earns the surface; icomoon glyph retreats to a footer-utility role

hero.ground: white (page surface) with full-bleed photo to viewport edge

captionPlate.content: eyebrow FINANCE · h1 FINANCING DEALS & SPECIAL OFFERS · supporting line · primary CTA BROWSE MORE SERVICES

financeBand.position: moved BELOW service tiles (was second viewport; now third)
financeBand.rationale: Photography gets the second-viewport oxygen; finance is still above the fold of typical scroll depth but no longer competes with the hero for primary canvas.

serviceTiles.fallback: where no equipment photo exists for a service category, render the icomoon glyph on a warm-stone tile with a dashed PLACEHOLDER · photo-needed signature so the missing-photo gap is visible

supportPartnersBand.treatment: Wheeler_Campus photo as section background at low contrast (rgba(255,255,255,0.85) overlay) with sentiment + partner-logo strip floating in card
supportPartnersBand.rationale: Improvement #2 inherited; campus photo adds a place-of-business signal that text-only couldn't carry

hits.rule: Hero text on photographic background without contrast scrim
hits.justification: E avoids the rule by using caption-plate instead of text-over-photo. The plate IS the scrim equivalent — opaque white ground with sharp edges. Type lives on the plate, not the photo.

antiToolboxAudit.rationale: Single bet (photography re-foregrounding). The one anti-toolbox hit is brand-faithfully resolved via caption-plate composition.

extensions.photographyMaturityNote: Captured photography is product-documentation tier (WordPress media library, not editorial commissions). E renders at editorial scale honestly — the exposure is the presales artifact. Recommend a photo commission roadmap as a parallel deliverable; the rendered file would dramatically improve with editorial-grade equipment portraits at the same composition.
